C513.why: Y501's 100 nF bypass (schematic p5) beside its supply pins 1 and 4, both on in-pad 3V3 vias; had sat 8 mm away on the top side

why: 50 MHz RMII oscillator and its two series resistors at its output, with its bypass cap. Placed so the clock to U501 pin 27 (32 mm, In2) and to U401 ball U6 (22 mm, B) are within Microchip's 13 mm, the PHY's the longer (it helps TX setup); the bucks' switch nodes 17.9 mm away or more.
